architecture.mechanism: Hydrogel swelling to achieve non-zero cracking pressure and prevent reverse flow leakage
architecture.intervention: Integrate a hydrogel-based check-valve structure within the shunt valve that swells upon fluid exposure to regulate flow and close against obstruction
architecture.expected_effect: Restoration of CSF drainage with negligible reverse flow leakage and prevention of blockage through passive, swelling-controlled valve closure
architecture.falsification_test: Evaluate the hydrogel valve in ex vivo CSF and brain tissue environments; measure reverse flow leakage and confirm zero backflow while maintaining a non-zero cracking pressure under varying intracranial pressures
